paper_metadata.title: A Low-Power Low-Noise Ultrawide-Dynamic-Range CMOS Imager with Pixel-Parallel A/D Conversion
paper_metadata.abstract: A CMOS image sensor with pixel-parallel analog-to-digital (A/D) conversion fabricated with different array sizes and photodiode types in a three-metal 0.5m process is presented. Nominal power dissipation is 40 nW per pixel at 3 V. A/D conversion results from sampling a free-run- = 3 ning photocurrent-controlled oscillator to give a first-order – sequence. The sensor displays dynamic range capability of greater than 150 000 : 1 and exhibits fixed pattern noise correctable to within 0.1% of signal. Terms—Analog–digital conversion, image sensors, Index sigma–delta modulation, smart pixels. Fig. 1. 3T voltage-mode pixel schematic.
